verdict.rationale: Filee documents an official CLI (`filee convert <files|wildcards|folders> --to <format>` or `--preset`) that uses the app's engines. It is automation-friendly: `--json` gives machine-readable output and exit codes 0–3 are scriptable. Silent installer flags and a portable ZIP support unattended provisioning, and watch folders add hands-off automation. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that the CLI runs without a GUI or display (truly headless), a documented CI recipe or example, and independent hands-on corroboration of CLI use in CI.
